observations.visual: Inspected desktop full-story and narrow full-page screenshots: no visible text clipping, overlapping sections, or responsive overflow.
observations.foodLogging: Five desktop logging paths converge on Review Before Save; narrow view uses one centered downward connector.
observations.foodEndBehavior: RESULTS remains aria-current at max story scroll minus 3px; CLOSE is active at max. Clicking LEARNING sets #food-workflow but after settled bottom scroll CLOSE remains aria-current.
observations.choEndBehavior: All five chapter clicks settled to the matching aria-current. At 390px, actual mouse-wheel scroll away changed HUMAN REVIEW to FIT MODEL; ordinary +800px / +1200px wheel inputs or two +500px increments to bottom selected WHAT CHANGED at document max.
observations.semantics: Food system figure is named “Food Tracker system map.”; Cho architecture figure exposes its architecture name and ordered role discovery/candidate evidence/decision layer/product action content. Figures are not keyboard stops and contain no focusable descendants. AX snapshot only; screen-reader announcements were not tested.
observations.errors: No console, page, request-failed, or HTTP error responses in the captures.
